sources.provenance: Khronos WebGL Working Group extension registry
sources.reason: Fabric R03 already cites and implements its polling semantics; the spec explicitly says non-blocking polling is likely to take the same total link wall time.

sources.reproducibility: PerformanceMark and PerformanceMeasure behavior has Web Platform Tests
sources.boundedNovelty: Named monotonic marks and measures can bind each startup span to an exact run instead of inferring the critical path from one phase-local number.

sources.reproducibility: longtask-timing tests are published in web-platform-tests/wpt under BSD-3-Clause
sources.boundedNovelty: A supported PerformanceObserver can expose UI-thread tasks of at least 50 ms that phase totals alone do not reveal.

integrationRisk: Low for instrumentation-only trial; no runtime dependency or production algorithm change. The browser must record unsupported APIs as Unknown rather than silently pass.
